static_traits.name: Zhan Ming
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with colleagues are strained by frequent reassurance-seeking；有一位亲密朋友但not yet充分分享Self-doubt的程度
static_traits.medical_history: 既往not yet有类似心理问题；not yet接受过心理治疗；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、能自我Reflection、配合度Good；语速Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: 在上一次校对任务中犯错后（被同事指出），开始出现without能感和低自我价值；问题发展为Persistent self-doubt与害怕再犯错，每天在Work中（尤其处理重要文档时）过度分析、怀疑自己的能力，并Frequently seeking reassurance from colleagues，仍难以缓解。
basic_info.core_demands: 意识到这些without能感和Self-doubt正在影响Work质量并造成显著困扰，因此寻求咨询以改善现状。

special_situations.event: A colleague points out that she missed several errors in the report she proofread last week
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果在Work中被指出错误，就说明我not称职，do not人会认为我without能
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Frequently seeks reassurance from colleagues and tries to recover evaluations through apologies and doubling care
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我在这份Work很糟糕，大家都觉得我not称职

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Must achieve zero errors to count as qualified; otherwise one is a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly checking, being overly careful, working overtime just in case
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I make another mistake, I am done for

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 在压力下也必须完美表现，否则说明I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly checks every detail, raises vigilance, compresses rest
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 在这么紧的期限下我一定会犯错，证明我not行

special_situations.event: When reviewing work performance, focuses only on mistakes and ignores positive feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有错误才能反映真实能力；正面反馈not算数
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores or downplays others' praise and positive evidence
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那些表扬都not重要，我还是not够好

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as competent, to be seen as a capable professional
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被评价为without能、被羞辱，甚至因此失去Work或人际信任
defense_goal: 通过保持高标准与零错误来控制Anxiety
Seeks reassurance from others to feel safe
Uses over-analysis to keep distance from emotions and maintain a sense of control

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的、容易犯错的员工
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh others who pick faults and judge at any time (colleagues / supervisors)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When colleagues or the counselor point out/discuss his mistakes, or invite him to examine evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 潜意识将对方视为评判者，认为自己会被贴上“not称职”标签
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Lists processes and details in an analytical tone, avoiding talking about feelings of shame and fear, and downplays emotion with objective terms.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or colleagues give positive feedback or encouragement
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为这些肯定not真实或只是礼貌，推断他人其实看not起自己（Projection）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use怀疑和质疑的语气，强调他人“真正的想法”是负面的，回避接纳正面信息。

manifestations: Relationships with colleagues are strained by frequent reassurance-seeking
有亲密朋友但not yet分享Self-doubt的程度
At work, finds it hard to trust one's own ability, hard to build genuine connections with others

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 在会谈与Work中频繁Self-doubt与自我批评
Overly cautious when performing tasks, checking repeatedly

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 在Colleague pointing out mistakes后认为“大家一定觉得我not称职”
Skeptical of the counselor's affirmation and infers the other party is only being polite

positive_force: Once received positive feedback from colleagues on work quality
Has close friends as potential support resources
Willing to try an 'alternative perspective'; holds an open attitude toward counseling
Serious work attitude; proactively improves thoroughness
negative_force: Catastrophizing, overgeneralization, all-or-nothing thinking, and mind reading/personalization tendencies
Frequently seeks reassurance from others; depends on external validation
Sleep affected与Decreased concentration，进一步削弱绩效

target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing of mistake consequences and fear of others' negative evaluation (mind reading/personalization)
target_behavior.function: 寻求外部验证以暂时缓解Anxiety与not确定感

target_behavior.core_reason: All-or-nothing standard and overgeneralization, forming the belief that 'only zero errors count as qualified'
target_behavior.function: Trying to avoid mistakes and gain a sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Work质量下降、Increased stress、睡眠与专注受影响

target_behavior.behavior: 在被指出错误时出现明显的Anxiety与生理反应（心跳加速、胃部绞痛、头痛）
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizing predictions about consequences and fear of losing ability evaluations
target_behavior.function: 促使回避或缩减风险情境，以降低短期Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired attention further affects work performance
